title: PermissionContext
description: The typed runtime context passed to the permission-decision function when an agent requests a tool call. Represents all facts available at decision time.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this permission request. Used to correlate allow/deny responses with pending requests.

decision_required_by.description: Deadline for the decision. If no response by this time, the runtime defaults to 'deny'.

session.description: Context about the session making the request.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent definition (e.g. YAML name or .md filename stem).

agent_source.description: Origin of the agent definition. 'remote' means the agent was spawned from a remote-runtime or ACP delegation.

is_subagent.description: True if this session was spawned by an orchestrator agent.

tool.description: The tool being requested and the arguments it was called with.

arguments.description: Raw arguments object passed to the tool. Structure is tool-specific.

estimated_side_effects.description: Side-effect categories predicted by static analysis of the tool and arguments. Advisory only.

is_destructive.description: True if the tool is classified as destructive (delete, overwrite, exec with side effects).

policy_match.description: The policy rule that matched this request, if any. Null means no explicit rule; default behavior applies.

matched_pattern.description: The glob or regex pattern in the rule that matched this tool call.

approval_context.description: Additional context to surface in the approval UI when decision = 'ask'.

display_arguments_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the arguments (not the raw object).

risk_label.description: Risk label to show in the approval prompt.

suggested_decision.description: The runtime's suggested decision based on policy and heuristics.
